description: This file contains tests for tailnet helper functions related to network interfaces and IP address identification, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within the tailnet IPv4 range 100.64.0.0/10.

methods.name: listTailnetAddresses
methods.description: Lists unique non-internal IPv4 and IPv6 addresses assigned to network interfaces.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Selects the first available tailnet IPv4 address from network interfaces.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv6
methods.description: Selects the first available tailnet IPv6 address from network interfaces.
